# ChatGPT can now turn your ideas and images into sticker packs: Here’s how to try it
OpenAI has added a sticker-making feature to ChatGPT, allowing users to create and customise packs of up to nine AI-generated stickers from a simple text prompt, then share them through apps such as WhatsApp and iMessage.

OpenAI is now bringing that format into ChatGPT with a new feature that lets users generate personalised sticker packs using artificial intelligence.

The feature is powered by ChatGPT Images 2.0, OpenAI's latest image-generation model, and allows users to turn written prompts into a collection of stickers. Rather than generating a single image, ChatGPT can create up to nine stickers as part of one pack.

Options include Anime, 3D and Holographic designs, allowing the same idea to be interpreted in different ways.

## How to create stickers on ChatGPT
Creating a sticker pack begins with opening the ChatGPT app on a mobile device and entering a prompt describing the kind of stickers you want.

For instance, a user could ask ChatGPT to generate a sticker pack featuring their kitten in different moods or reactions.

ChatGPT Images 2.0 then generates the sticker collection, with up to nine stickers included in a pack.

The completed pack can then be downloaded or shared through supported messaging platforms, including WhatsApp and iMessage.

## Eligible users
They can generate sticker packs directly within ChatGPT by describing what they want to create.

For users, the process is straightforward: open ChatGPT on a phone, describe an idea, select a visual style and generate the pack.
